To be clear, here is a handy, Xbox-provided guide to how and when you can play Grand Theft Auto VI .

articles.t: Tove Lo Releases “Blood In Your Eyes” for the GTA 6 Soundtrack
articles.chapeau: Tove Lo releases “Blood In Your Eyes” for the GTA 6 soundtrack, featured in Rockstar’s pre-load video.
articles.txt:
Tove Lo releases “Blood In Your Eyes” for the GTA 6 soundtrack, with the new song featured in Rockstar Games’ pre-load video ahead of launch.
Tove Lo has joined the growing musical rollout for Grand Theft Auto VI with a new song, “ Blood In Your Eyes ,” featured in Rockstar Games’ pre-load video and included on the official Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album . The track arrives November 10, as pre-loading opens for players who pre-ordered the highly anticipated game ahead of its November 19 release.
Rockstar announced the song alongside the video, giving fans another preview of the music shaping the next chapter of the Grand Theft Auto series. “Blood In Your Eyes” is part of the official soundtrack collection, which is now available on major streaming platforms.
The release adds another recognizable name to a soundtrack that has been unveiled through a steady sequence of artist announcements and singles. Rockstar and Atlantic Records first announced Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album on September 17, describing a 34-track collection of original recordings connected to the game. The project has since become a major part of the campaign leading up to the November 19 launch.
Previously revealed contributions include Yung Lean’s “That’s It,” featuring Future and Metro Boomin; Travis Scott’s “RHYNO”; “Sexy Magic” by CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso with PinkPantheress, Fred again.. and Etienne de Crécy; Morgan Wallen’s “Last Thing You Need”; Rauw Alejandro’s “Macacoa 2000”; and Keith Richards’ “Bright Lights, Big City.” Cardi B also entered the rollout with the surprise release of “Don’t Chart.”
The music campaign is extending beyond the game and streaming services, too. On November 21, two days after the release, Rockstar will stage GTA VI: The Festival at Mana Wynwood in Miami, bringing several of the soundtrack’s artists together for a live event inspired by the fictional world of Vice City. Cardi B, Travis Scott, Don Toliver, Kodak Black, Sofaygo and Metro Boomin are among the performers, alongside CA7RIEL & Paco Amoroso, Justice, Tainy, Rauw & Friends and others.

articles.t: GTA 6 Is The Most Preordered Game Of All Time For PlayStation And Xbox
‘GTA 6’ officially launches next week and is available for pre-load now: Everything you need to know about the highly anticipated Rockstar game
articles.chapeau: Grand Theft Auto 6 arrives on November 19. Here's everything you need to know ahead of its launch.
articles.txt:
If you buy something through a link in this article, we may earn commission.
Grand Theft Auto 6 arrives on November 19. Here's everything you need to know ahead of its launch. (Rockstar) More than 13 years after GTA 5 launched on consoles, Grand Theft Auto 6 is nearly here — and developer Rockstar isn't playing around. GTA 6 looks to be much more detailed and immersive than GTA 5, and it's likely to be the biggest game launch of the decade. In fact, it's already estimated to have brought in $750 million in preorders across PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series consoles. Rockstar isn't going small with promotion, either; it just announced a one-day music festival in Miami featuring artists from the game's soundtrack on Nov. 21.
The game is set to let players freely explore the state of Leonida — essentially a Florida analog — including the legendary Vice City. It even features fully functional bus and train schedules , which is a level of detail that may contribute to speculation that it'll be the most expensive game ever made . And as a teaser, Rockstar has released more than 40 new screenshots of the game ahead of launch.
If you're thinking about joining in on the frenzy right at launch, we've rounded up everything you need to know to get started.
Grand Theft Auto 6 launches globally on November 19, 2026, placing it squarely in the busy holiday shopping season. The game has been delayed a couple of times in the past, but there's no sign of that happening again this close to release.
If you pre-order digitally, you'll be able to start playing right at midnight local time on November 19. The initial launch will only feature the single-player story mode, so don't expect to be able to jump into online multiplayer right away.
At launch, GTA 6 will only be available for current-generation game consoles. That means you can only play it on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X or Xbox Series S. While we've seen some other modern games also launch on PlayStation 4 and Xbox One, GTA 6 is skipping them altogether due to the high technical demands of the game's world and systems.
GTA 6 (PlayStation 5) $80 at Amazon GTA 6 (Xbox Series X|S) $80 at Amazon How much does GTA 6 cost? GTA 6 is a little more expensive than normal new game releases, coming in at $80 for the standard edition. For diehard fans, there's also the Ultimate Edition and a physical Collector's bundle that, weirdly, doesn't include the game. Here's how it breaks down.
Standard Edition ($79.99): Includes the complete base game with the full single-player campaign. Available both digitally and in physical stores.
Ultimate Edition ($99.99): Exclusive to digital platforms. Includes the full game, alongside bonus cosmetics, in-game vehicles and property vouchers for online play.
Collector's bundle ($399.99) : Officially called "Grand Theft Auto VI: The Goodtime State – Vice City Collection," this bundle doesn't include a game code. However, it packs a lot of physical collectibles that GTA fans will enjoy, including a Macca the Gator figure, Oakley sunglasses, a snapback hat and more.
There's an important caveat, however, if you're planning to buy a physical copy in stores. The game box doesn't include a disc. Instead, you'll get a digital code that you can redeem on your console's store.
Yes! If you pre-order GTA 6 before its November 19 launch, you'll get the Vintage Vice City pack. It includes various retro-inspired Vice City cosmetics, along with an exclusive car, the '55 Vapid Stanier. It also includes one free month of GTA+.
While it's not a preorder bonus, there are also rumors that Rockstar is collaborating with Travis Scott and Nike to drop a set of Air Force 1 Low '07 RS collection sneakers in three colorways on November 19 to mark the launch of the game. Rockstar already collaborated with French electronic duo Justice on the soundtrack for the game, so it wouldn't be surprising to see other pop culture collabs.
While it's not quite a collaboration, Xbox is also marking the occasion by giving away a one-of-a-kind Xbox Series X inside of an alligator. Yep, you read that right.
GTA 6 takes place in the fictional state of Leonida, which includes Vice City.
Rockstar has revealed that GTA 6 will require up to 212GB of free space , depending on which console you're playing on. That would make it double the file size of Rockstar's last game, Red Dead Redemption 2 . articles.t: 'GTA 6' on PS5 vs. Xbox: What we know
articles.chapeau: Rockstar has been somewhat forthcoming about what to expect from 'GTA 6' on PS5, but what about Xbox?
articles.txt:
Grand Theft Auto VI is less than two weeks away, which means it's time to sort out which console you're going to play it on at launch, if you haven't already.
The problem there is that Rockstar Games has given us precious little information to go on regarding how the game looks and runs on PS5 versus the Xbox Series consoles. The official marketing spin has been that GTA 6 "plays best" on PS5 for months now, but Rockstar had not greatly expanded on what that means...until now.
In a statement that coincided with the game becoming available for pre-load on Tuesday, Rockstar elaborated a little bit on what to expect from each console version of the game, while also sharing a new 30-second trailer. According to Rockstar, GTA6 will target 30 frames per second on every machine at launch, which is not a surprise given the level of visual fidelity on display.
Rockstar also said the PS5 Pro version will support PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (or PSSR), a special technique the PS5 Pro uses to enhance game resolution. Beyond that, PS5 Pro users will have access to ray-traced shadows, meaning (presumably) that every shadow in the game will react realistically to light sources. No other console version of the game will support this feature, at least not at launch.
We've already seen the base PS5 version running in the big Netflix trailer back in August, but Rockstar elaborated a bit on that version, too. It'll include haptic feedback in the DualSense controller, improved 3D audio, and faster load times, though the wording on the load times bit is a little bit vague. We don't know what the point of comparison is, though one could reasonably assume they're talking about the Xbox version.
Unfortunately, Rockstar's post was still extremely light on Xbox details. The post reiterated that the game will be available via Xbox Cloud Gaming for those who like to stream games, and that the streaming build will use the Xbox Series S visual settings. That is, I believe, the first confirmation that the less powerful Series S will have its own visual settings, but Rockstar didn't say anything about what those settings actually entail.
Rockstar also did not mention the Series X version at all. On balance, the Series X is roughly as powerful as a PS5, and most multi-platform games look and run very similarly across both devices. articles.t: Même Sur PS5 Pro, GTA VI Reste à 30 FPS : Le Surplus De Puissance Profite à L’image
articles.chapeau: GTA VI sort le 19 novembre avec une limite de 30 FPS sur consoles. La PS5 Pro ajoute le PSSR et les ombres en ray tracing ; le préchargement est disponible.
articles.txt:
La machine la plus puissante de Sony n’offrira pas davantage d’images par seconde que les autres. Rockstar privilégie la qualité visuelle, quitte à maintenir le même plafond de fluidité sur toute la génération.
Le préchargement de Grand Theft Auto VI est désormais accessible aux joueurs ayant précommandé le jeu, dont la sortie est fixée au 19 novembre . Le studio confirme une limite de 30 FPS sur consoles , retenue pour assurer la stabilité et préserver le niveau de détail.
Rockstar indique avoir consacré d’importantes ressources à l’optimisation des GPU intégrés aux consoles. Ce travail ne débouche toutefois pas sur une cadence supérieure : les différences entre machines porteront notamment sur les technologies de rendu disponibles.
La PlayStation 5 Pro bénéficie ainsi du PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) et d’ombres calculées en ray tracing, deux fonctions qui lui sont réservées. La PlayStation 5 standard prend en charge le Quick Spectral Super Resolution (QSSR), une version simplifiée du PSSR, mais cette technologie ne sera pas utilisée dans le jeu au lancement.
Le supplément de puissance de la Pro sert donc ici la reconstruction d’image et les ombres, pas la fluidité. Pour les joueurs qui envisageaient cette console dans l’espoir d’une fréquence d’affichage plus élevée, la distinction est importante : le plafond reste identique.
La version PlayStation 5 exploite le retour haptique de la DualSense tout au long du jeu, avec des ajustements accessibles dans les paramètres d’accessibilité. Elle propose également un son spatialisé amélioré via Tempest 3D Audio et des temps de chargement réduits.
Les Xbox Series X|S ne bénéficient pas de traitement particulier. Les utilisateurs de Xbox One pourront en revanche jouer en streaming via Xbox Cloud Gaming , avec les réglages graphiques de la Xbox Series S.
Cette possibilité ne correspond donc pas à une version exécutée localement sur Xbox One. La qualité de la connexion et les autres contraintes techniques du streaming pourront affecter l’expérience par rapport à une exécution locale. Le Remote Play sera par ailleurs pris en charge sur PlayStation comme sur Xbox.

articles.t: GTA 6 is targeting 30 fps and has ray-tracing support on PS5 Pro - Engadget
articles.chapeau: Xbox Cloud Gaming support means you’ll be able to stream GTA6 on Xbox One.
articles.txt:
Xbox Cloud Gaming support means you’ll be able to stream the game on Xbox One.
Rockstar Games Add Engadget on Google: Preferred Source Google Discover Along with making Grand Theft Auto 6 available to pre-load on Xbox Series X/S and PlayStation 5, Rockstar Games has revealed what fans can expect in terms of performance when the game goes live on November 19. The studio said it's targeting 30 frames per second "while pushing both platforms to their absolute limits to bring the vast and rich world of Leonida to life — while maintaining the density and visual fidelity of all its environments and inhabitants." There's no mention in Rockstar's blog post of 40 fps or 60 fps support on PS5 Pro, but perhaps that'll come down the line.
The game will have a couple of boosts on Sony's higher-end console, though. It will support Sony's PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution upscaling tech . For the foreseeable future, PS5 Pro will be the only way to play the game with ray-traced shadows, but that'll surely change when GTA 6 inevitably lands on PC .
Rockstar added that there's "high-fidelity haptic feedback fully integrated across the game" for DualSense controllers, along with "improved spatial audio" to make full use of Tempest 3D Audio on PS5. Moreover, the studio said there are improved load times on Sony's consoles too.
As expected, there's remote play support for both PlayStation and Xbox. You'll be able to play GTA 6 via Xbox Cloud Gaming on consoles (including Xbox One) too. Rockstar pointed out that cloud streaming will be limited to Xbox Series S graphics settings, but that still might be worth considering if you don't feel like dedicating all that precious console storage space to GTA 6 .
In addition, Xbox and PlayStation both said GTA 6 is the most pre-ordered game ever on their respective storefronts. Also of note, Xbox CEO Asha Sharma wrote on X that "today marks the first step in our new 10-year strategic partnership with [Rockstar parent] Take-Two." Xbox Cloud Gaming will support more Rockstar Games titles in the coming months, including Grand Theft Auto 5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 .

articles.t: Xbox Vs. PS5: GTA 6 Specs Revealed, And These Are The Biggest Differences
articles.chapeau: "Pushing both platforms to their absolute limits"
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games has today lifted the lid on a bunch of specs for both the Xbox and PS5 versions of GTA 6 , revealing some of the biggest differences (and similarities) between playing the game on each platform.
The most notable bit of information is that every single console runs the game at 30FPS. Regardless of whether you're playing on Xbox Series S, Xbox Series S, PS5 or even PS5 Pro, the max you're getting is 30 frames per-second.
"Grand Theft Auto VI has been fully developed from the ground up to provide the best possible experience for the current generation of consoles, targeting 30 frames per second while pushing both platforms to their absolute limits to bring the vast and rich world of Leonida to life — while maintaining the density and visual fidelity of all its environments and inhabitants."
There will obviously be resolution differences between each platform, but Rockstar has yet to reveal these details. Expect the Series S to fare the worst, the PS5 Pro to fare the best, and the Series X and PS5 to be pretty much equal.
Rockstar does say that GTA 6 "plays best" on PS5 though (and let's not forget that Sony appears to have a marketing deal in place with Rockstar Games for this release), highlighting the differences between the PS5 and Xbox versions as being "high-fidelity haptic feedback" for the PS5 DualSense controllers , improved spatial audio rendering, and bizarrely, improved load times. That last one is surely just a minimal advantage at best!
Grand Theft Auto VI for PS5 includes high-fidelity haptic feedback fully integrated across the game on DualSense controllers and adjustable via accessibility settings, improved spatial audio rendering so all in-game sounds take full advantage of Tempest 3D Audio, and improved load times, making Grand Theft Auto VI play best on PlayStation 5 consoles.
Beyond that, the PS5 Pro version will benefit from improved clarity via PSSR along with ray-traced shadows.
However, the Xbox version has one massive benefit in the form of Xbox Cloud Gaming . It seems Xbox will be the only platform offering cloud streaming for GTA 6 at launch, making it an exclusive of sorts - at least for now. The bizarre bit is that it only appears to be for consoles, rather than other devices like PCs and mobiles.
The Xbox and PS5 versions will also support Remote Play (allowing you to cast your game to another device from your console). Nothing has been said about Quick Resume yet on Xbox , but we assume it'll be supported as well.
Ultimately, GTA 6 is bound to run great regardless of whether you buy it on Xbox or PlayStation, and the "plays best on PS5" differences mentioned by Rockstar Games appear to be minor advantages rather than major ones.
We can't wait for footage to start appearing online next week — especially for the Xbox Series S version — and here's hoping it's going to live up to the ridiculous hype that's been fueling the past decade. Not long to wait at all now!
How are you feeling about these specs so far for GTA 6? Tell us in the comments section down below.

articles.t: GTA 6 Now the Most Preordered Game in PlayStation Store and Microsoft Store History, Official Preload Warning Issued
articles.chapeau: Sony has confirmed that GTA 6 is now the most preordered game in PlayStation Store history, although it failed to put a number on it. Microsoft hasn’t made an announcement on GTA 6 preorders for Xbox Series X and S.
articles.txt:
Sony has confirmed that GTA 6 is now the most preordered game in PlayStation Store history, although it failed to put a number on it.
In a post on the PlayStation Blog , Sony Interactive Entertainment Content Communications Manager, Tim Turi, said Sony had seen “unprecedented demand” for Rockstar’s next game. Preload is now live ahead of the rolling midnight launch by country ( we’ve got the global release times right here ) from November 19.
According to data from sales tracking firm Sensor Tower, GTA 6 has already "sold" 9.69 million units, suggesting it's the most preordered game of all time, surpassing CD Projekt's Cyberpunk 2077. This week, Rockstar parent company Take-Two said GTA 6 preorders were tracking "far in excess of our initial expectations, and we know that the numbers will speak for themselves soon enough." According to Take-Two, some gamers are saving their money for GTA 6, skipping recent releases in the process .
Similarly, Microsoft has now confirmed that GTA 6 is the most preordered title of all time on the Microsoft Store. The company today confirmed GTA 6 will be playable on Xbox Series X and S and even Xbox One via Cloud Gaming , but not PC or mobile. Microsoft also announced it will add more Rockstar games to Xbox Cloud Gaming, including Grand Theft Auto 5, Red Dead Redemption 2, in the coming months.
Sony and Microsoft both issued a warning that fans should preload the game as soon as possible, perhaps mindful of the weight of demand that is heading the their online stores next week.
“Given the anticipation for Grand Theft Auto VI, we strongly advise that everyone who is hoping to play on launch day to preload the game as soon as possible,” Turi said. “Players who purchased the code-in-box version can also activate their code as soon as they get it to begin preloading. If you still haven’t pre-ordered the game, now’s the time to do so to make sure you’re ready for November 19.”
Today’ Rockstar finally confirmed some of the performance specs for GTA 6 , including exclusive PS5 Pro graphics features. Essentially, GTA 6 is targeting 30fps across all consoles, including Xbox Series S.
On PS5, GTA 6 includes integrated speakers, haptic feedback and adaptive triggers across the game through DualSense wireless controllers, and adjustable via accessibility settings. “All in-game sounds take full advantage of Tempest 3D Audio for highly accurate audio positioning, while load times are improved with PS5’s ultra high-speed SSD, making Grand Theft Auto VI play best on PlayStation 5 consoles,” Sony said.
This week, IGN interviewed Take-Two boss Strauss Zelnick to talk GTA 6 expectations , Online, and what the next decade looks like. We’ve also got a report on the hunt for information dataminers are currently on following the launch of GTA 6 preload .

articles.t: GTA VI sera accessible en streaming mais pas sur Mac, PC ou iPhone

articles.txt:
Si vous vous intéressez (même de loin) au monde des jeux vidéo, vous ne l'avez probablement pas raté : Grand Theft Auto VI ( GTA VI ) sort le 19 novembre. Et comme pour chaque lancement de GTA depuis quelques années maintenant, Rockstar limite le lancement aux consoles Sony et Microsoft. Pour GTA VI , le jeu n'est donc accessible que sur les consoles Xbox Series et PlayStation 5. Si certains espéraient pouvoir jouer sans console, par exemple en passant par le Xbox Cloud Gaming, Rockstar vient de doucher leurs espoirs.
Reprenons les bases. Microsoft propose plusieurs solutions de streaming pour les joueurs. GTA VI ne sera évidemment pas disponible dans le Xbox Game Pass, qui est une sorte de Netflix des jeux vidéo et qui permet de jouer à de nombreux titres en payant un abonnement, sans acheter le jeu directement. Mais dixit la page de Rockstar , il sera proposé tout de même dans le Xbox Cloud Gaming, avec un achat. Mais avec un twist .
En temps normal, il est possible de jouer à des jeux Xbox (les versions pensées pour les consoles) sans même avoir de Xbox. Vous pouvez acheter un jeu en ligne et jouer sur un PC, un Mac, un smartphone, une console, etc. Mais dans le cas de GTA VI , Rockstar est explicite : le streaming ne sera accessible que depuis une console Xbox Series ou une Xbox One (la génération précédente), et donc pas depuis un téléviseur, un Mac, un iPhone, etc. Par ailleurs, les parties dans le cloud seront exécutées depuis des Xbox Series S, la console d'entrée de gamme de Microsoft. Le résultat devrait donc être visuellement moins bon que sur les autres consoles.
Cette limitation touche aussi certains appareils qui sont pourtant vendus comme des « XBox », comme une variante de la console ROG Ally d'Asus, que nous avons testé.
Test de la ROG Ally : une console portable musclée sous Windows 11
Pour les joueurs PC, bien évidemment, la question la plus importante est simple : quand GTA VI sera-t-il disponible ? Avec Rockstar, c'est parfois un peu compliqué : GTA V a été lancé en septembre 2013 et il a fallu attendre avril 2015 pour en profiter sur PC. Même chose pour Red Dead Redemption 2 : il est sorti en octobre 2018 et la version PC n'est arrivée qu'en novembre 2019. Et pour la version Mac, sauf si Apple décide de sortir le chéquier, il y a malheureusement peu de chances de la voir débarquer un jour. Rockstar n'a en effet proposé aucun des titres de la série sur Mac, et s'est contenté de remake un peu paresseux sur les appareils iOS.
La trilogie GTA remasterisée arrivera sur iOS le 14 décembre pour les abonnés Netflix
Notons enfin que Rockstar précise que le streaming depuis votre propre console, lui, est accessible. Donc il reste techniquement possible de jouer sur PC, Mac ou iPhone… si vous avez la console sous la main.

articles.t: Rockstar détaille les améliorations de GTA 6 PS5 Pro et confirme un objectif de 30 FPS
Rockstar reveals GTA 6 console performance targets and PS5 Pro upgrades
articles.chapeau: Rockstar Games has confirmed that GTA 6 will target 30 FPS across the PS5 and Xbox Series X|S consoles, including the PS5 Pro. Sony's upgraded console will instead receive exclusive ray-traced shadows and PSSR upscaling, while a 60 FPS performance mode remains unconfirmed.
articles.txt:
With Grand Theft Auto VI preloads now underway, Rockstar Games has finally shed more light on how its highly anticipated open-world title will perform on current-generation consoles. As many had suspected, the game will target 30 FPS across the PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S lineup, including Sony's more powerful PlayStation 5 Pro.
According to Rockstar's official announcement , the 30 FPS target was chosen to maintain the density and visual fidelity of Leonida's expansive open world. This effectively puts an end to speculation about the PS5 Pro delivering a substantially higher frame rate at launch, although Rockstar has not explicitly ruled out additional graphics modes.
Instead, the PS5 Pro will distinguish itself through improved image quality. Rockstar has confirmed support for PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR), Sony's AI-powered upscaling technology, alongside ray-traced shadows exclusive to the upgraded console.
Interestingly, recent datamining findings suggest that GTA VI could use a newer implementation of PSSR than existing PS5 Pro titles. References to version 13.60 were discovered in the preload metadata, compared with version 13.00A reportedly used by games such as Cyberpunk 2077 and Assassin's Creed Shadows .
Another interesting discovery is a reference to 120 Hz output . This has fueled speculation about a possible 40 FPS mode in GTA 6 , which would provide a middle ground between 30 FPS and 60 FPS on compatible displays. A 40 FPS presentation can fit evenly into a 120 Hz refresh cycle, making it a viable alternative for graphically demanding games. However, the presence of a 120 Hz option does not confirm that Rockstar intends to offer it.
The preload metadata also reportedly lacks references to QSSR , Sony's newer upscaling solution for the standard PS5. That does not conclusively rule out its inclusion in the final game, but it suggests that the base console may not receive the same upscaling improvements as its Pro counterpart.
Beyond graphical enhancements, Rockstar has confirmed that the PlayStation 5 version will support DualSense haptic feedback, improved spatial audio through Tempest 3D Audio and optimised loading times. The developer has not detailed equivalent platform-specific enhancements for the Xbox Series X or Series S. Not that there are too many to begin with, except Quick Resume, maybe.
It is worth noting that the 30 FPS target does not necessarily guarantee a locked frame rate under all circumstances. Similarly, Rockstar has not disclosed the rendering resolutions or graphical compromises required for the Xbox Series S, which has considerably less GPU power and available memory than the Series X.
GTA 6 launches on November 19, 2026, for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Preloads are already available, with Rockstar confirming that players will need up to 212 GB of available storage, depending on their console.

articles.chapeau: À l’approche de Grand Theft Auto VI, Strauss Zelnick promet des jeux Rockstar développés plus vite. Cette annonce relance l’espoir d’un GTA 7 bien plus proche qu’on ne le pense.
articles.txt:
À l’approche de Grand Theft Auto VI, Strauss Zelnick promet des jeux Rockstar développés plus vite. Cette annonce relance l’espoir d’un GTA 7 bien plus proche qu’on ne le pense.
Treize ans séparent Grand Theft Auto V (2013) de Grand Theft Auto VI , attendu le 19 novembre 2026 sur PS5 et Xbox Series X|S. Un cycle record qui a parfois épuisé la patience des fans, pendant que Rockstar Games redéfinissait son moteur, son open world façon Vice City et tout son pipeline de production.
À quelques jours de la sortie de GTA 6 , le patron de Take-Two Interactive , Strauss Zelnick , prépare déjà « l’après ». Ses déclarations, combinées à celles de cadres de Rockstar, laissent entendre que le prochain épisode majeur, potentiellement GTA 7, pourrait arriver plus vite . Mais jusqu’où faut-il y croire ?
Dans une interview citée par 01net, Strauss Zelnick affirme qu’ »il est possible que les évolutions récentes de la technologie nous permettent de réduire certains délais de développement sans compromettre la qualité, et nous l’espérons ». Le message est clair : l’éditeur veut raccourcir les cycles sans toucher au niveau de finition qui a fait la réputation de Rockstar.
Interrogé par IGN, il va plus loin : « Nous pensons que la nature et la vitesse du contenu que nous verrons pour nos franchises emblématiques, y compris GTA, seront très différentes au cours de la prochaine décennie. Et cela est vraiment porté par notre engagement de premier plan dans l’industrie à proposer des divertissements de la plus haute qualité, à atteindre nos joueurs de nouvelles façons et en de nouveaux endroits et à maintenir l’engagement de nos consommateurs après la sortie. » Zelnick ne prononce ni « GTA 7 » ni de date, mais installe l’idée d’un rythme plus soutenu.
Côté studio, Bloomberg rapportait que les responsables de Rockstar « promettent que leur prochaine sortie ne prendra pas huit ans à faire ». Là encore, aucun titre n’est cité, mais tout le monde pense au successeur de GTA 6 . Selon plusieurs développeurs, l’effort colossal engagé sur ce dernier doit enfin payer : refonte profonde du moteur maison RAGE (Rockstar Advanced Game Engine), outils internes modernisés et production pensée dès le départ pour être réutilisable.
Concrètement, Rockstar ne veut plus « tout démonter à chaque épisode ». Le studio a presque doublé ses effectifs, passant d’environ 2 441 employés en 2018 à 4 711 en 2026, et a investi dans un projet estimé entre 1 et 2 milliards de dollars , soit environ 900 millions à 1,8 milliard d’euros. L’idée est que cette base technique, construite pour l’État de Leonida et Vice City dans GTA 6 , serve de socle pour des jeux suivants développés plus vite.
À ce stade, GTA 7 n’a rien d’officiel : pas de logo, pas de teaser, aucune plateforme annoncée. Les projections qui circulent pour une sortie entre 2032 et 2035 reposent surtout sur des calculs de fans. Si Rockstar tient sa promesse d’un « prochain jeu » développé en moins de huit ans, un lancement autour de 2033 à partir de 2026 paraît cohérent, mais cela reste un scénario théorique, pas une fuite.
Il faut aussi compter sur la stratégie longue durée de Rockstar. GTA 5 a vécu plus de dix ans grâce à GTA Online, et tout indique que GTA 6 bénéficiera du même traitement, avec des années de mises à jour pour rentabiliser son budget record. Les déclarations de Strauss Zelnick et des cadres de Rockstar invitent donc surtout à penser que l’on n’attendra probablement pas 13 ans pour le prochain gros jeu, mais elles ne garantissent ni un « GTA 7 » nommé comme tel, ni une date précise. Pour l’instant, la seule certitude, c’est que l’attente commence à peine pour l’après Vice City.

articles.t: GTA 6 sur PC et en version disque : le patron de Take-Two répond enfin aux joueurs
articles.chapeau: Entre précommandes record et colère des joueurs PC, GTA 6 arrive sur PS5 et Xbox Series sans disque classique ni date Windows claire. Après l’intervention très mesurée de Strauss Zelnick, que peuvent encore espérer les joueurs français attachés au physique ?
articles.txt:
Entre précommandes record et colère des joueurs PC, GTA 6 arrive sur PS5 et Xbox Series sans disque classique ni date Windows claire. Après l’intervention très mesurée de Strauss Zelnick, que peuvent encore espérer les joueurs français attachés au physique ?
À quelques jours de la sortie de GTA 6 , présentée comme le plus gros lancement de divertissement de l’histoire, une question fâche encore les joueurs : où sont passées la version PC et le bon vieux disque dans la boîte, surtout pour le public français ?
Lors de la dernière conférence financière de Take-Two Interactive , le 9 novembre, le directeur général Strauss Zelnick a été interrogé de front sur Grand Theft Auto VI : version PC, vraie édition disque, éventuel portage Nintendo Switch 2 . Sa réponse est tombée, et elle en dit plus par ce qu’elle évite que par ce qu’elle confirme.
Pendant cet appel, les investisseurs se sont surtout focalisés sur GTA 6 , dont les précommandes explosent. L’une des questions clés visait l’après lancement : arrivée sur PC , existence d’une vraie version disque, voire possibilité de porter le jeu plus tard sur une éventuelle Nintendo Switch 2 .
Zelnick a esquivé toute date ou confirmation, en rappelant, cité par Variety, que « l’information vient toujours de nos labels », en l’occurrence Rockstar Games . Autrement dit, ni la version PC de GTA 6 , ni une hypothétique édition sur disque, ni un portage Switch 2 ne seront annoncés par la maison mère : si quelque chose change, cela viendra directement de Rockstar, pas du PDG.
À ce jour, le site officiel de Rockstar Games ne liste Grand Theft Auto VI que sur PlayStation 5 et Xbox Series X|S , avec une sortie mondiale fixée au 19 novembre 2026. Les éditions dites « physiques » disponibles en précommande en France ne contiennent en réalité qu’un code de téléchargement, expédié dès le 12 novembre pour permettre le préchargement du jeu sur console.
Selon une source proche du dossier citée par The Hollywood Reporter et reprise par Frandroid et Clubic, Rockstar Games n’aurait prévu aucun pressage de disques GTA 6 , ni au lancement ni dans les mois suivants : la « copie physique » mentionnée par le support désigne bien cette boîte avec code unique. En France, ces boîtes sont affichées à 79,99 € pour l’édition Standard et 99,99 € pour l’édition Ultimate, sans Blu-ray à l’intérieur.
Côté PC, l’historique parle pour Rockstar Games : GTA 5 comme Red Dead Redemption 2 sont d’abord sortis sur console avant d’arriver plusieurs mois plus tard sur Windows. Rien n’est annoncé pour l’instant, mais une version PC de GTA 6 reste logique à imaginer à moyen terme, même si ce calendrier demeure purement spéculatif.
Pour les joueurs français, il faut donc voir GTA 6 comme un achat dématérialisé : la boîte expose le jeu en rayon, mais aucun disque à prêter ou à revendre.

articles.t: GTA 6 Online Launch Date Coming Soon? Check Multiplayer Leak

articles.txt:
Copied Is GTA 6 Online release on the cards? It certainly will launch, but the conversation is on about when - soon, or sometime in the nebulous future. GTA Online has been one of gaming’s biggest cash cows for over a decade, so it was never going to be simple when it came to GTA 6 Online's plans. This game is all about the multiplayer mode and most gamers consider it to be as good as, if not better, than the single-player mode. While rumours have suggested the online mode might not arrive until sometime in 2027, a fresh discovery from data miners is complicating that timeline.
Buried inside the GTA 6 release date build are strings suggesting multiplayer groundwork already exists, even if it won’t be switched on come launch day.
The findings come from PlayStation Game Size , who dug through the GTA 6 release build and spotted references including “joinSession,” “launchActivity,” and “launchMultiplayerActivity.” These strings point toward functionality for creating or joining sessions, exactly the kind of backend groundwork multiplayer features typically need.
That said, none of this confirms online mode is landing on November 19th, it simply suggests Rockstar may have built the framework in advance so a future rollout can slot in smoothly rather than arrive as a bolt-on later.
History offers some hope for an early-ish arrival too. GTA Online famously launched just two weeks after GTA 5’s solo campaign, while Red Dead Redemption 2’s multiplayer beta surfaced roughly a month post-release. Still, Bloomberg’s Jason Schreier has downplayed expectations of an imminent announcement, suggesting fans may be waiting until 2027 for co-op missions to materialise. Why the wait? Well, Rockstar took some 13 years to roll out GTA 6. GTA 6 Online getting delayed is par for the course.
GTA Online remains an enormous earner for Rockstar even today, and that profitability alone gives the studio little incentive to rush players away from it.
Twitch CEO Dan Clancy has echoed similar sentiment, noting that a 2027 GTA 6 Online launch would likely generate a much bigger viewership spike than an earlier rollout squeezed in alongside the base game’s launch hype.
Adding to the intrigue, Discord logs from a past Rockstar employee tribunal referenced a 32-participant multiplayer test session dating back to October 2025, suggesting internal testing has been underway for a while now.
With GTA 6 pre-loads beginning November 10th in New Zealand before spreading worldwide, data miners are expected to keep digging, and more clues about GTA 6 Online release date may not be far behind.

articles.t: GTA 6 Preorders Beat Forecasts as NBA 2K27 Falls Short
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 preorders are tracking far above Take-Two's plan before the Nov 19 launch, while NBA 2K27 missed its forecast. What the Q2 numbers mean for you.
articles.txt:
Take-Two says GTA 6 preorders far exceed its plan 10 days before the Nov 19 launch, but net bookings fell 18% to $1.6B as NBA 2K27 missed. Here's why.
Take-Two Interactive says GTA 6 preorders are "tracking far in excess of our initial expectations," ten days before Grand Theft Auto VI launches on November 19, 2026. The publisher shared the update with its fiscal second quarter results on November 9, but it did not give a single preorder number.
The same report shows the other side of a GTA year. NBA 2K27 sold more than 4 million copies and still missed Take-Two's forecast, and CEO Strauss Zelnick believes GTA 6 itself is part of the reason.
Strong enough for Take-Two to use very big words. In the official earnings release , Zelnick said, "The launch of Grand Theft Auto VI is ten days away and, with pre-orders continuing to reach unprecedented levels, we expect to deliver an historic year for our company."
On the earnings call he added that "the numbers will speak for themselves soon enough." That is a polite way of saying the real figures come after launch. GTA VI arrives on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and Take-Two's lineup table still lists no PC version. If you have not set up your console yet, our GTA 6 preload guide covers start times and the 212GB download.
NBA 2K27 came out on September 4 and posted the second best net bookings in the series' history. Net bookings is Take-Two's main sales measure: everything it sold digitally or shipped to stores in the period. Even so, the game landed below the company's own target.
Zelnick told IGN, in comments reported by Kotaku , "It has been a crowded period, and we do think that GTA 6 coming has had an influence on the consumer." In other words, some players may be saving their money for Vice City. He was relaxed about it with Bloomberg: "If your lunch is going to be eaten, I'd rather be the one eating it." President Karl Slatoff was more careful on the call, saying "it's really hard to know exactly" why the game fell short.
The quarter ended on September 30, so it contains no GTA VI sales at all. Recurrent consumer spending, meaning money players spend inside games they already own (virtual currency, add-ons and in-game purchases), fell 9%. Take-Two had guided for a 5% drop.
Net bookings also missed Take-Two's own range of $1.62 billion to $1.67 billion, and Bloomberg says Wall Street expected about $1.65 billion. The full year outlook of $8.0 billion to $8.2 billion stayed the same, and the October to December quarter alone is guided at $3.35 billion to $3.50 billion. GamesIndustry.biz notes that operating costs should rise about 21% in that quarter, mostly because of GTA 6 marketing.
Mostly, it suggests November 19 is holding. Take-Two repeated its $8 billion forecast and its launch date ten days out, with no hint of another delay. Rockstar's older game is still a giant too: GTA V has sold nearly 235 million copies, and the GTA+ membership grew by double digits last quarter.
Expect heavy server traffic and a crowded launch week, much like the pressure Sony pointed to when it discussed falling PS5 sales ahead of GTA 6 . PS5 Pro owners also have something to look forward to, since a datamine points to a 120Hz mode for GTA 6 .
A publisher calling its own preorders "unprecedented" is not proof, so the real test is the first sales figure after launch. Still, the NBA 2K27 miss tells us something useful: GTA 6 is pulling money out of gamers' wallets before it even ships. For Take-Two, a weak quarter is the price of one of the biggest game launches ever, and it looks happy to pay it.

Sony has advertised PS5 consoles as the best way to play Rockstar’s new title . Some owners of Microsoft’s gaming systems have felt overlooked as the marketing campaign unfolded. Still, a leak of the physical case confirms the GTA 6 Xbox version has exclusive visual and sound perks.
Ahead of the November 19th GTA 6 release date , images of the PS5 retail box already spread on social media. Instead of a map, Rockstar enclosed a double-sided poster. Now, videotech has shared the back of the Xbox case, which reveals details on compatible video and audio formats.
Series X and S loyalists should expect Dolby Vision and Dolby Atmos as options. Dolby Vision can have advantages over HDR with dynamic metadata optimized for specific scenes. The result is more accurate colors and brightness levels in games and movies.
Frustratingly for home theater enthusiasts, Xbox consoles offer Dolby Vision, but rival PS5 hardware does not. PlayStation fans rely on the still-very-capable HDR10 . Regardless, OLED TV brands like Sony and LG promote Dolby Vision as a selling point.
Although much of the focus has been on graphics, cinematic Rockstar projects also have immersive sound. The physical GTA 6 Xbox case explains that Dolby Atmos spatial audio will be available on Microsoft’s systems. Games using the technology produce precise positional effects reflecting the on-screen action.
By popular request, the PS5 added Dolby Atmos support in a September 2023 update. Even so, games are calibrated for Sony’s Tempest 3D audio first, before it's translated to Atmos. The end product varies and can be just as impressive, if not superior. Nevertheless, many listeners prefer the alternative in surround sound setups with height speakers.
Revelations about the GTA 6 Xbox version are unlikely to change the reported large gap in pre-order sales . Preload leaks hint the PS5 Pro will provide a higher frame rate or refresh rate. Otherwise, analysts anticipate performance on the Series X and base PS5 console to be comparable.

articles.t: GTA 6 Preloads Nov. 10: $79.99, No Disc Included [2026]
articles.chapeau: GTA 6 launches Nov. 19 at $79.99 with preload from Nov. 10 and no disc. What Take-Two confirmed and what the biggest-release claim lacks.
articles.txt:
Rockstar Games is one day from opening downloads for Grand Theft Auto VI . Pre-loading begins November 10, 2026, and the game launches November 19, 2026, on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Coverage from Cinelinx and Nintendo Life has framed the run-up as the build toward the biggest release in entertainment history, a label the publisher itself has not claimed.
That gap between headline and record book is the real story today. The confirmed facts are strong on their own: a $79.99 standard edition, pre-orders that opened at midnight local time on June 25, 2026, and a physical edition that ships as a download code with no disc. Our earlier look at the install-size claims circulating before preload showed how quickly unverified numbers spread when a release gets this big.
This analysis separates what Take-Two Interactive and Rockstar have actually confirmed from what the market is projecting. It covers the timeline, the price, the packaging, the money at stake for Sony and Microsoft, and four predictions for launch week. Anything the official sources do not state stays marked as unconfirmed.
Google · Preferred Sources Don't miss new tech stories on Google
Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
Start with the short list of facts that hold up under scrutiny. Grand Theft Auto VI is developed and published by Rockstar Games, a label owned by Take-Two Interactive Software, Inc. The release date is November 19, 2026. The launch platforms are PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. The standard edition costs $79.99.
Pre-orders began June 25, 2026, at midnight local time, which means players in each region saw the store pages open as their own clock rolled over. Pre-loading starts November 10, 2026, so anyone who ordered digitally can have the files on their console before launch day. Standard physical versions contain a download code and do not include a disc, per the official release information.
Take-Two describes the game as featuring “a single-player experience set in the biggest, most immersive evolution of the series yet.” That sentence is the closest the publisher comes to a superlative. It describes the game relative to earlier entries in the series. It makes no claim about the wider entertainment industry, and that distinction matters when headlines start to stretch it.
The table below sorts the public record into what is confirmed and what is not. Treat the second column as a watch list rather than a set of facts.
The GTA 6 release date has been stable in the official materials, and that consistency counts for something. Players have had months to plan around November 19. The only dated checkpoint left before launch is the preload window opening on November 10, and the three confirmed dates run in order: pre-orders on June 25, preload on November 10, launch on November 19.
Pre-loading is more than a convenience. When a download of this scale opens, network providers, console storefronts and publishers all see a demand spike days before the game even unlocks. A staggered preload spreads that load across the nine days before launch instead of concentrating it on the morning of November 19. Players who wait until launch day to start downloading take on avoidable risk.
Neither Take-Two nor Rockstar has published an official install size in the sources available to us. Numbers are circulating anyway, and they come from leaks. Until the storefronts show a size on the pre-load page, plan for a large download and free up space rather than trusting any single figure.
A $79.99 standard edition is a premium price for a console game, and it shows how much confidence Take-Two has in this title. Publishers rarely push a price up on a game they expect to struggle. Setting the number at $79.99 is a bet that demand will absorb it.
That bet has consequences beyond this one title. If buyers pay $79.99 without visible resistance, other publishers will read the result as permission to move their own flagship prices up. If buyers balk, the next round of pricing decisions across the industry gets more cautious. Analysts and rival executives will watch pre-order momentum and launch-week chatter for exactly this signal.

articles.txt:
PlayStation 5 database discoveries suggest Rockstar is preparing GTA 6 Online, but could its PC release be part of the plan?
Grand Theft Auto 6 is almost here, but Rockstar Games still hasn't said much about what comes after its single-player campaign. That could be about to change, though, as discoveries in the game's PlayStation version suggest that work on GTA 6 Online is already underway.
This comes from ' PlayStation Game Size ', an account known for tracking PlayStation database updates and uncovering game information ahead of official announcements. In its latest findings, it identifies three multiplayer-related entries associated with GTA 6 : 'joinSession', 'launchActivity', and 'launchMultiplayerActivity'.
While that's encouraging for anyone anticipating the next evolution of GTA Online, it doesn't confirm that the mode will be available alongside the November 19 launch, or tell us when Rockstar plans to introduce it. Dataminer ' TexFunz2 ' claims that GTA 6's single-player and online components could be installed separately.
If that's accurate, players might eventually be able to remove the campaign while keeping the multiplayer experience installed, which would be particularly useful given the game's reported 210GB download size.
So, where does that leave the PC version? Rockstar hasn't officially announced one, but a recent report from GamesBeat cites four industry sources familiar with the studio's plans, claiming that it's targeting the first quarter of 2027. That would put the PC release just a few months after the console launch, a considerable improvement on GTA 5's PC port, which arrived around 19 months after its original release.
It's worth remembering that GTA Online originally launched two weeks after GTA 5 in October 2013, while Red Dead Online arrived roughly a month after Red Dead Redemption 2. Rockstar could take a different approach this time, considering that GTA 5's multiplayer was particularly rough at launch. Let's hope history doesn't repeat itself here.

Dix jours avant la sortie, les fichiers des plateformes ont parlé : 55 trophées au lancement, dont une énigme à 1 000 points. Rockstar, fidèle à son silence, n’a rien confirmé.
Rockstar verrouille la communication autour de GTA 6 depuis des années, malgré les fuites massives qui ont émaillé son développement. La liste des trophées vient pourtant de sortir par la bande, repérée dans les fichiers des plateformes de Sony et de Microsoft.
Le jeu arriverait avec 55 trophées sur PS5, platine attendue comprise, et autant de succès sur Xbox Series. Les deux plateformes racontent la même chose chacune de leur côté, ce qui donne du poids à l’extraction sans la confirmer. L’auteur du relevé a volontairement tu les noms, pour ne rien divulgâcher de l’histoire. À titre de comparaison, GTA 5 s’était lancé avec 49 succès sur Xbox 360 et 50 trophées sur PS3, Red Dead Redemption 2 avec 51 et 52. Le nouveau venu dépasserait donc ses aînés, d’une courte tête.
Sur Xbox, un jeu répartit d’ordinaire ses 1 000 points de score entre des dizaines de succès. La liste extraite aligne ici 54 entrées modestes, échelonnées de 1 à 54 points, auxquelles s’ajoute une entrée unique créditée de 1 000 points . Deux lectures circulent : un succès « mythique » , distinction rare que Microsoft réserve aux exploits hors norme, ou une valeur provisoire posée pour les tests internes. Une capture douteuse évoquait d’ailleurs 58 trophées l’an dernier ; ces chiffres extraits avant l’heure bougent parfois d’ici au lancement.
Impossible, à ce stade, de savoir si la liste couvre le seul mode histoire ou si le volet en ligne y prendra part plus tard. Rien ne dit non plus que tout sera décrochable dès le lancement. Le décompte renseigne de toute façon assez mal sur l’ampleur ou la difficulté réelles d’un jeu. Red Dead Redemption 2 et ses 52 trophées passent encore pour un platine particulièrement redouté.
Le préchargement ouvre comme prévu le 10 novembre à minuit sur PS5 et vers 1 heure du matin en France sur Xbox Series, avec un téléchargement qui grimpe jusqu’à 212 Go suivant la machine. Les acheteurs de versions en boîte devront patienter jusqu’au 12 novembre pour récupérer leurs codes chez les revendeurs. La sortie reste calée au 19 novembre sur les deux consoles , à 79,99 euros en édition standard et 99,99 euros pour l’Ultimate numérique ; le déverrouillage à minuit demeure officieux.

La liste des trophées s’ajoute ainsi aux 25 minutes d’images de jeu parties dans la nature début octobre, dans l’indifférence publique du studio. Rockstar a bien confirmé, début novembre, les modalités du préchargement et le poids du téléchargement ; sur les trophées, silence complet. Rien ne garantit, d’ailleurs, que les valeurs repérées tiendront jusqu’au 19 novembre. Pour le joueur, le vrai rendez-vous reste la nuit du 10 : 212 Go à faire passer avant la ruée.

articles.t: GTA VI Trophies Leak: 55 Rewards Reported [2026]
articles.chapeau: Leaks put GTA VI trophies and achievements at 55 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar has not confirmed the count or published any names.
articles.txt:
A new leak puts the reward list for Grand Theft Auto VI at 55 entries on each major console family. Reports from Notebookcheck, Neowin, Shane the Gamer, Root-Nation, Around Prague and eGamers.io all point to the same figure: 55 PlayStation 5 trophies and 55 Xbox Series X|S achievements. The number comes from datamined information, not from Rockstar Games, Sony or Microsoft.
That distinction drives everything below. Rockstar has not published a trophy or achievement list, any names, any descriptions or an official count. Players have seen a total and little else. Earlier leaks around this launch, such as the Xbox file size leak we covered, followed the same pattern of hard-looking numbers with no official sign-off.
This analysis separates what the reporting supports from what it does not. It also looks at why the story spread so fast, how PlayStation and Xbox reward systems differ, and what the leak means for the weeks before launch. Readers who follow our gaming coverage will recognize the approach: attribute every claim, label every guess.

Add Shattered once in the Google app and our stories show up in your news suggestions.
The headline number is simple. Reporting says GTA VI carries 55 trophies on PlayStation 5 and 55 achievements on Xbox Series X|S. Outlets describe the match across both platforms as the main reason the figure looks credible, since two separate sets of data landed on the same total.
Notebookcheck framed its write-up around the comparison with the previous numbered entry in the series, with a headline that says the new game has more PS5 trophies and Xbox achievements on release date than GTA 5 . Shane the Gamer ran a dedicated post on the 55 leak. Neowin, Root-Nation, Around Prague and eGamers.io carried the same core claim. None of these outlets quote Rockstar, Take-Two Interactive, Sony or Microsoft on the record, and none claim to hold the actual list.
So the verified portion of this story is narrow. A figure of 55 exists in leaked or datamined information. Several outlets reported it. Nobody with authority over the game has confirmed it. Every other detail attached to the story, from point values to hidden rewards, sits in softer territory, and the sections below mark that line clearly.
The wording matters for search readers too. People typing GTA VI trophies or GTA VI achievements into a search box want a list. This leak gives them a count. Anything promising names or unlock conditions at this stage deserves suspicion, because the fact sheet behind this report says no such details have been verified.
Datamining means pulling information out of game files, store back-ends or platform services before the publisher chooses to reveal it. For trophy and achievement lists, the data often sits in configuration files that platform holders need ahead of launch. Sony and Microsoft both require developers to register reward sets so the services can display them when a player unlocks something.
That plumbing explains why counts leak while content stays hidden. A system can know that 55 slots exist without exposing what each one is called. Reporting on this leak fits that picture. The count surfaced and the text did not, which is consistent with data that has been configured but not yet localized or made public.
It also explains why caution is warranted. Datamined values can be placeholders, test entries or leftovers from earlier builds. The reports we reviewed do not claim otherwise. They present the number as a leak and note that the official storefront listings are where confirmation would eventually appear.
A pattern from earlier in this launch cycle is worth recalling. Our piece on the build leak and its three online strings showed how fragments of data get read as proof of far more than they can support. The trophy story carries the same risk, only with friendlier stakes.
Sorting claims by confidence keeps the story honest. The table below groups every detail in circulation by how well the reporting supports it. Only the first three rows reach the level of confirmed reporting, and even those confirm that outlets reported a number, not that the number is final.
Three points hold up. The 55 figure comes from leaks and datamining. Rockstar has said nothing official about the list. The same total appears for PlayStation and Xbox. Those three facts are all a careful writer can state without hedging, and each depends on how the outlets frame

articles.t: GTA 6 Menu Music Surfaces as PS5 Preloads Begin
articles.chapeau: GTA 6's PS5 home-screen theme has surfaced as preloads opened in New Zealand. Here's what we know, and when UAE, Saudi and Egypt players can start.
articles.txt:
A calm, 80s-style synth track is the first real sound of GTA 6 on PS5, and your own preload window is closer than you think.
0:00 GTA 6 has made its first sound on console. Insider Gaming reports that PS5 preloads opened in New Zealand, and players there started posting clips of the game’s PS5 home-screen music: a soft, synth-heavy track with a distinct 80s feel. It plays when you highlight the GTA 6 icon, so you don’t need to launch anything to hear it.
One of the clips came from the @gtasix_ account, which called it the first listen to the GTA 6 main menu theme on PS5.
BREAKING: First listen to the GTA 6 main menu theme on PS5. pic.twitter.com/kowKEt55l6
Treat it as the dashboard theme for now. TweakTown notes that the track plays from the PS5 home screen and may differ from the music in GTA 6’s own menu. Insider Gaming expects the two to match, but that’s a guess until people can boot the game on 19 November.
Found us on Google? Add tbreak as a preferred source to see more of our stories in Top Stories.
The order comes down to time zones. According to Rockstar’s support page , PS5 digital preload begins at midnight local time on 10 November 2026, so New Zealand, which is among the first places to reach that midnight, got there first. Xbox Series X|S works differently, with a single worldwide start at 12am GMT on 10 November.
For readers in the Gulf and Egypt, that means PS5 players in the UAE can start downloading at midnight tonight, UAE time. Xbox owners get the same window at 4am in the UAE, 3am in Saudi Arabia and 2am in Egypt. Rockstar’s page also says the game itself still releases at midnight local time on 19 November on both consoles.
The date is earlier than originally listed. Pre-order details published in June pointed to a 12 November preload, which is the date in our pricing and editions coverage . gHacks reports that Rockstar’s Newswire has since moved it to 10 November and says the preload file needs up to 212 GB depending on your device.
Early readings from live consoles suggest you’ll want more than a token amount of free storage. RockstarINTEL cites an X user for a PS5 download of about 209.75GB (212GB installed) and roughly 225.34GB on Xbox Series X|S. It also says anyone with a boxed copy, which contains a download code rather than a disc, can queue the install from the Xbox phone app without waiting to enter the code.
The music is part of a wider push on the audio side. Rockstar’s launch trailer , published on 15 October, features music from the electronic duo Justice, credited as composers of the original score. The same description points to an official soundtrack album, GTA VI: The Album, which was open for pre-save at the time.
When can I preload GTA 6 in the UAE? On PS5, preload opens at midnight local time on 10 November, which is tonight in the UAE. On Xbox Series X|S it opens at 12am GMT, or 4am UAE time. Check that you’ve got 212GB or more free first, since Rockstar’s figure is “up to” and Xbox downloads are reported to be larger.
That’s unconfirmed. The track plays when GTA 6 is highlighted on the PS5 dashboard, and it may differ from the music in the game’s own menu.
No. Rockstar says GTA 6 releases at midnight local time on 19 November on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, in all regions.

articles.t: GTA 6 PS5 Pro to have updated PSSR 2 and 120Hz, but QSSR unlikely for base console
articles.chapeau: Metadata leaks from the preload build have shed light on GTA 6 PS5 Pro performance upgrades. Gamers should be able to activate a 120Hz refresh rate, potentially at 40 fps. The Rockstar project may also use a revamped implementation of PSSR 2 upscaling, while the base console lacks QSSR.
articles.txt:
Despite the GTA 6 release date being close, PS5 Pro perks remain unclear. However, datamining of the preload build has uncovered some performance details. The Rockstar game should offer a 120Hz refresh rate mode, hinting at a 40 fps option. A new version of PSSR 2 is also likely, but the base console may not benefit from QSSR upscaling .
Leading up to its launch, fans have debated what benefits the GTA 6 PS5 Pro upgrade would bring. On GTAForums , Tex2 leaked findings that include signs of a 120Hz toggle. On the other hand, VRR isn't supported, which in many enhanced games points to a 40 fps setting.
PSSR 2 is AI-powered upscaling that produces sharper visuals even when a title renders at a lower native resolution. The GTA 6 PS5 Pro version appears to have a refresh of the technology not seen before.
Unfortunately, the base console may not share the same advantage. Sony introduced QSSR on October 1st as an alternative to the flagship system’s PSSR. So far, it has been limited to first-party projects like Marvel’s Wolverine and Ghost of Yōtei . Tex2 discovered no evidence of the upscaling approach in the preload build.
The latest leak still leaves options on the more affordable console in doubt. According to Rockstar North co-lead Rob Nelson, developers are aiming for 30 fps on the November 19th release date. Based on existing trailers , Digital Foundry believes Leonida's dense open world makes it difficult to exceed that mark. A 1440p internal resolution upscaled to 4K is also likely.
The price of the PS5 Pro has skyrocketed as the component shortage has impacted manufacturing. A possible 40 fps/120Hz mode may not justify the steep investment. Regardless, gamers should wait until Rockstar and PlayStation confirm GTA 6 performance settings before any last-minute upgrade.
